dedupe_keys.name: oslo surface absorption data based on land use land cover classification

description: FAIRiCUBE publishes a surface-absorption raster for Oslo derived from a land-use and land-cover classification. Zenodo lists one public GeoTIFF, roughly 0.6 MB, under CC BY 4.0. Surface absorption can be used as a spatial input when testing urban-heat or radiative conditions around buildings and public spaces. This is a derived city layer, not measured surface temperature or a full urban climate model. The landing page does not specify the absorption unit or scale, classification classes, date of the source map, calibration method or validation. Those gaps limit quantitative interpretation and should be checked before coupling it to an energy-balance model. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Oslo layer. The raster was not downloaded; its coordinate system, band values and nodata representation remain unchecked. The suggested infrastructure use is a reviewer classification, not a use demonstrated by the provider.
